notes.title: Full release is here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723773/ef7531db80d855b2e36142164c6e577219de90f4.jpg

 Full game release is here today!

Kobi is a senior Scottie dog, who is moving to a new place with his owner and a favorite toy pig, just to find out that the old house (with the spacious backyard and a bird feeder 😌) is full of unsolved mysteries and a whimsical creatures. 
  Moreover, our grumpy protagonist finds his toy pig is missing, and, caught up in a hot pursuit of the thieves, he finds himself in a curious hidden world. We need to help him get home. After all, it's almost dinner time.

 Have fun!

notes.title: Steam release date is here!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723773/a5e2a979f4c1409e72700eca2960e070fc4230d8.jpg

"The Empress Quest Full Moons Saga" adventure game have a full release date now!
  Immerse yourself in a cute and cozy summertime story, full of whimsical characters and unexpected turns!
 Help Kobi the Scottie dog to find his friend Empress and to get back home.
Story-reach plot, hand-painted, vibrante backgrounds and traditional frame-by-frame animations - all perfectly glazed with the music by Eric Matyas.

Mark the date and wishlist on Steam!🐽

notes.title: Demo update! (0.0.56.1)
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42723773/4e241517a42f7ba4e3d747fae4cfa594965979df.jpg

Demo update! (0.0.56.1)

Changes:

 Now it's easier to find Branchiata.
 You can't have a lighter twice.
 More frequent random/idle animations.
 More smooth storytelling process.
 Minor bugs fix.


No changes:

 Kobi is still a dog.
 Empress is cute.


Before launching a new version of the game, please delete your old saves folder just in case. 
Thank you.
